articles.summary: Checkr now owns both Truework and Truv, and Equifax has absorbed Vault Verify, so the Argyle alternatives list looks different than it did a year ago. Here are the six main options, the three models they represent, and why coverage claims and completion rates are not the same number.
articles.title: Best Argyle Alternatives for Employment Verification (2026)

articles.summary: Employers verify a high school diploma through an instant database lookup, a district records request, or a direct call to the registrar. The Clearinghouse's DiplomaVerify covers 9,000+ schools across 47 states, but that leaves most of the country's high schools to manual outreach.
articles.title: How Do Employers Verify a High School Diploma?

articles.summary: The Work Number's published price starts at $73.45 per report. Lenders suing Equifax put individual verifications at $66.45 in 2024, up from under $20 a decade earlier. Here is how the billing actually works, and what you pay for records you never asked for.
articles.title: How Much Does The Work Number Cost?

articles.summary: Healthcare background check requirements stack five core checks: criminal history, federal exclusion lists, licensure, employment and education history, and abuse registries. Which apply depends on the role and the state. This guide maps them and shows where the process stalls.
articles.title: Healthcare Background Screening: Requirements by Role

articles.summary: We routed 19,363 randomized employment verification calls across four TTS voice models and scored them on one thing: did the call end with a completed verification. Bland Speech v3 came out 27% ahead of the field.
articles.title: We Tested Four Voice Models on 19,000 Verification Calls. Bland v3 Won.
